# Import

In this section, we *import* the dataset given in week 2. But of course, right before that we have to load the relevant libraries (I think?)

```{r, output=FALSE}
library("readr")
library("survival")
library("tidyverse")
clinic_data <- read_csv("data/clinic_raw.csv",skip=2)
```

Tada! We have assigned the datasets as an object in our environment. Next, we'll go through wrangling, which we usually spend \>90% of our time on, especially when collaborators don't understand the utility of standardising the work :(

# Wrangle and Summary

We'd usually like to sanitise the data before going into the operating theatre\~ but we gotta know what we're working with first.

```{r}
summary(clinic_data)
head(clinic_data)
```

For purposes of this exercise, let's choose to describe *blood pressure by sex*. From the above output, we can see that we have 200 patients in this dataset. There are mixed spellings in sex, and blood pressure is currently behaving as a character string. We'd need to *wrangle* both variables before we can use them for analysis.

## Sex

```{r}
clinic_data$sex <- ifelse(
  toupper(clinic_data$sex) == "M","Male"
, ifelse(toupper(clinic_data$sex)=="F","Female",NA)
)
```

We cleaned up the "sex" column.

## Blood pressure

```{r}
clinic_data$bp_sys <- as.numeric(str_extract(clinic_data$blood_pressure,"^[0-9]+"))
```

We have just extracted "123" from "123/45 mmHg" to create a new column "bp_sys".

We can now proceed with a **t test** to compare if there is an association between gender and systolic blood pressure.

# Analysis

```{r}
t.test(clinic_data$bp_sys~clinic_data$sex)
```

Since p-value is \>0.05, we have **failed to reject the null** and conclude that there is no association between systolic blood pressure and sex.

# Visualise

```{r}
clinic_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex), !is.na(bp_sys)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = bp_sys)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x="Sex",
       y="Systolic BP")
```

This gives us a **box-plot** to visualise the distribution of systolic blood pressure! Thank you for reading through my nonsense /bows/
